name: task-tracker
description: User Management & Task Tracker - full-stack monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.test: concurrently -k -s first -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm test --prefix backend" "npm test --prefix frontend"
